headline: OpenAI Files Counterclaims Against Apple, Accusing It of Stealing Trade Secrets
summary: OpenAI filed counterclaims against Apple in a California federal court, accusing the tech giant of stealing trade secrets and blocking its access to hardware suppliers amid an ongoing legal dispute.
why: OpenAI is a leading developer of artificial intelligence technologies like ChatGPT, while Apple is a dominant consumer electronics and software manufacturer. Legal disputes between major tech titans can impact their competitive positions.
